title: Implement an RPN stack machine in Rust
description: Implement eval(expr: &str) -> Result<i64, String> that evaluates a Reverse Polish Notation expression. Tokens are space-separated integers or operators +, -, *, /.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement eval(expr) in src/lib.rs:
- Split expr on whitespace, iterate tokens
- If token parses as i64: push onto stack
- If token is an operator (+,-,*,/): pop b then a, compute a op b; for / check b==0 and return Err; push result
- If unknown token: return Err
- After all tokens, pop and return the single remaining value; if stack is wrong size return Err
All 6 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test --quiet` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
